blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thirty-three percent of adult Filipinos expect the country’s economy to improve over the next 12 months, according to the latest survey of the Social Weather Stations (SWS). The SWS survey, conducted from June 20 to 29, 2026, and released on Monday, found that 24 percent expected the economy to worsen, while 32 percent believed it would remain the same. The remaining 11 percent did not give an answer.
